200.description: A text/event-stream of change signals for the signed-in recipient: `retry: 5000`, then `data: {"type":"ready"}`, then `data: {"type":"<signal>"}` lines and a heartbeat (a `: hb` comment and an `hb` event) every 20 s. Signals carry only a type, never data; on one, re-read the matching endpoints. 204 while live updates are off. 429 LIVE_LIMIT past 8 streams for one person; 503 LIVE_UNAVAILABLE (Retry-After: 30) when this copy is full or stopping.
